Q) LTXX/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3822N02559E357
A) LTBB LGGG B) 2612210600 C) 2612211000
E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNS:

THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO CLARIFY THE 'A4367/26' LGGGYNYX NOTAM ISSUED 
BY GREEK CAA. 
THE 'A4367/26' NOTAM ISSUED BY GREEK CAA CONSTITUES A BREACH OF 
GREECE'S TREATY OBLIGATIONS PERTAINING TO THE DEMILITARIZED STATUS 
OF EASTERN AEGEAN ISLANDS UNDER ''THE 1914 SIX POWERS' DECISION'', 
'THE 1923 LAUSANNE PEACE TREATY(WITH ITS ANNEX, THE CONVENTION 
RELATING TO THE REGIME OF THE STRAITS)' AND 'THE 1947 PARIS PEACE 
TREATY' LIMNI(LEMNOS)AND BOZBABA(AYA EVSTRATIOS) AND 
MIDILLI(MITYELENE) MENTIONED 
IN THE NOTAM AT REFERENCE HAS A DEMILITARIZED STATUS. THUS 
LIMNI(LEMNOS)AND BOZBABA(AYA EVSTRATIOS) AND MIDILLI(MITYELENE) 
AND/OR HER TERRITORY MUST NOT BE INCLUDED IN ANY SCENERIO/CONCEPT OF 
ANY 
MILITARY TRAINING OR EXERCISE.
